mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, isbn, publisher, publish_date, stock, category_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{publisher}, #{publishDate}, #{stock}, #{categoryId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, publisher = #{publisher}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, stock = #{stock}, category_id = #{categoryId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
